event_name: Date 23 October 2020 Time 17:56 2020 PORTUGUESE GRAND PRIX 22 to 25 October A team representative is required to report to the Stewards after the Drivers' meeting in relation to the incident below.
reason: Alleged breach of Article 24.2 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the driver of car 3 did not use the complete set of tyres of the same specification as allocated by the FIA. Technical Delegates report document 20. The Stewards Tim Mayer Felix Holter Vitaly Petrov Paulo Magalhaes
title: Summons Renault Tyre Use
